name: eldrin
description: Eldrin - Modular business application platform with multi-framework support

scripts.install:all: npm run install:submodules && npm run install:todos
scripts.install:submodules: git submodule update --init --recursive && git submodule foreach 'npm install 2>/dev/null || true'
scripts.install:todos: cd angular-todo && npm install && cd ../react-todo && npm install && cd ../svelte-todo && npm install && cd ../vue-todo && npm install && cd ..
scripts.build:all: npm run build:angular && npm run build:react && npm run build:svelte && npm run build:vue
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean:node_modules && npm run clean:dist
scripts.submodules:sync: git submodule sync && git submodule update --init --recursive

author: Eldrin Project
